description.zh:
是否启动存量关联资源跟随转组任务。取值：

- false：不启动存量关联资源跟随转组任务。
- true：启动存量关联资源跟随转组任务。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Transfer Existing Associated Resources feature. Valid values:

*   false
*   true

description.zh: 关联转组功能规则设置。

title.zh: 更新关联转组功能设置

descriptions.zh: 支持关联资源跟随转组的云资源，请参见[关联资源跟随转组](~~606232~~)。
descriptions.en: For information about the resources that support the Transfer Associated Resources feature, see [Use the Transfer Associated Resources feature](~~606232~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager update-associated-transfer-setting --rule-settings Status=Enable AssociatedService=ecs MasterResourceType=instance AssociatedResourceType=disk MasterService=ecs --enable-existing-resources-transfer false --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager UpdateAssociatedTransferSetting --region cn-hangzhou --RuleSettings.1.MasterResourceType instance --EnableExistingResourcesTransfer false --RuleSettings.1.Status Enable --RuleSettings.1.AssociatedResourceType disk --RuleSettings.1.MasterService ecs --RuleSettings.1.AssociatedService ecs --method POST --force
